name: aim (AI Manager) — Cloudflare Worker + D1
install: npm ci && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply aim-db --local --config worker/wrangler.local.toml

terminals.name: wrangler-dev
terminals.description: Local Cloudflare Worker (aim-ingest) with a local D1 database on http://127.0.0.1:8787. GET /healthz confirms it is up. Endpoints that require secrets return 503 until a gitignored worker/.dev.vars is provided.
